contracts.commit_point: Callback return at guardrails.py:122-126 — masking is committed in place and the request is allowed to proceed toward the Gemini API ('sanitizes and lets the call proceed').
contracts.declared_mechanism: ADK before_model_callback (guardrails.before_model_callback) registered on root_agent (agent.py:45); applies mask_pii to every text part, records redaction kinds to session state, and returns None so the sanitized request proceeds (guardrails.py:113-126).
contracts.forbidden_condition: An outgoing llm_request text part containing pattern-matched PII at the moment the request leaves for the Gemini API (guardrails.py:103-112: 'mask identifiers in every text part before the request leaves for the Gemini API'; 'the raw note never crosses the network with identifiers intact').

contracts.protected_operation: The outbound model request: before_model_callback traverses llm_request.contents[].parts[].text and rewrites matched spans in place on every request (guardrails.py:113-121).
contracts.protected_resource: The outbound request payload to the Gemini API (LLM request contents/parts text, including conversation history text).
contracts.protection_obligation: Patient identifiers must be masked in every text part of every outgoing LLM request (with conversation history re-masked each turn) before the request leaves for the Gemini API; the raw clinical note must not cross the network with identifiers intact.
scope_limits: Only parts with non-None .text are masked; function-response parts are untouched so terminology data is not mangled (guardrails.py:109-111, 114-121).
Regex-based masking with documented limitations (e.g., unlabeled names, guardrails.py:37-39); sanitize-not-block, never rejects the request (guardrails.py:126).
Effective only if ADK invokes the callback on every model request; the network transport itself is ADK framework code not in supplied source.

contracts.protected_operation: Argument passing for each allowlisted agent tool invocation: before_tool_callback scans and rewrites each top-level string arg in place via mask_pii before allowing the call (guardrails.py:77-91).
contracts.protected_resource: Outgoing tool-call arguments (args dict) destined for the terminology MCP tools / NLM APIs and the local validate_cpt tool.

scope_limits: Only top-level string values in args are scanned (isinstance(val, str)); nested lists/dicts are not recursed (guardrails.py:86-91).

Sanitize-not-block: detected PII is redacted and the call proceeds; only allowlist failures block (guardrails.py:82-91, 100).
